page.overview:
Who is Zirc?

Zirc is a grunt of the Explorers who is also one of Amethio's subordinates and a former antagonist appearing in .

Zirc is a gruff, brutish adult, who is merciless to anyone who opposes his boss Amethio. However, he has a soft side as a super fan of Nidothing. He is also very loyal to Amethio.
